title: keyboard
summary: Compatibility no-op for MATLAB keyboard debugging stops.
description: `keyboard` is accepted so MATLAB scripts containing manual debug stops continue to run under RunMat.
behaviors: `keyboard` accepts no inputs and returns no outputs.
RunMat currently treats it as a deterministic no-op. It does not enter MATLAB's interactive `K>>` debug prompt.
Interactive debugger suspension is a broader runtime/REPL feature and is not implemented by this builtin.

examples.description: Accept a manual debug stop without halting batch execution

faqs.question: Does RunMat enter an interactive debugger for `keyboard`?
faqs.answer: No. The command is accepted as a no-op until interactive debugger infrastructure exists.

gpu_behavior: `keyboard` is control-flow debugger compatibility and has no GPU/provider behavior.
